repair.rule: If the scheduled target document does not exist, retain clean retrieved documents, mark target_document_absent, do not count an applied/consumed intervention, and continue answering. Keep the question in all-question denominators; do not relocate the attack to a different document.
repair.scope: Secondary transfer evaluation amended after an assertion failure; primary context confirmation is unchanged. No model, question, target, template, decoding, scoring or checkpoint selection changes.
repair.compute: Only missing shard3 question-condition pairs are generated; previous predictions are retained byte-for-byte. One GPU per serial repair job on003.

storage.cleanup: Reuse completed shards via symlinks; retain original failed logs/predictions and new completion evidence. No duplicate model/dataset copies.

limitations: Prospectively frozen evaluation of completed training procedures; no retraining or checkpoint/seed selection.
